Rationale: Made is a high-frequency irregular past/participle form with independent recall value; keep the elementary make/do form rather than waiting for every make construction to be reconstructed.
For elementary learning the high-value reading is the irregular past form of think; the separate noun thought/想法 can be added later if it becomes a real learner need.
Material glass and an ordinary drinking glass form a close elementary concept cluster that can be disambiguated by the later example sentence; they do not justify a permanent blocker.
